summary: Tecogen Inc. filed an 8-K on August 31, 2026, disclosing a concurrent Form S-3 registration statement covering the reoffer and resale of 4,507,603 common shares held by selling stockholders from prior private placements. The Hatsopoulos 2012 Family Trust and The George N. Hatsopoulos GST non-exempt QTIP Marital Trust, holding 3,475,714 shares, signed lock-up agreements restricting disposition for 182 calendar days from SEC effectiveness. No price, premium, advisor or board recommendation disclosed. The registration lifts resale restrictions, creating potential supply overhang; watch effectiveness timing and lock-up expiry for dilution pressure on TGEN.
